The conv_transpose1d launcher will call cuDNN and therefore must be in a .cpp file per workspace rules, but this phase allows only .cu; however the contract says .cu may contain launchers using raw pointers and cudaStream_t and cuDNN is allowed. I will implement a cuDNN-based launcher inside custom_ops.cu using the C API (no torch/ATen/pybind). The binding layer later will provide tensors and current stream. Null/empty tensors and stride checks are performed in binding, while kernels assume valid contiguous tensors for the exercised shapes.
